projects.title: Clash of Pharaohs: Egypt Empire
projects.description:
Clash of Pharaohs: Egypt Empire was the first mobile game I self-published, developed during my final year of high school in 2017. It marked my entry into game development and sparked the passion that still drives me today. While it wasn’t my most technically polished work, it’s the game I’m most proud of—one that holds a special place in my heart.

The game was inspired by my love for ancient Egyptian history and mythology, especially the myth of Isis and Osiris, which explores themes of love, betrayal, and rebirth. That connection to the mythology is one of the main reasons this game remains so close to my heart.

Through this project, I not only learned the fundamentals of game development but also gained valuable experience in game publishing, App Store Optimization (ASO), and monetization strategies, leading to over 11,000 organic downloads. It was the beginning of my journey into both the technical and business sides of game creation.

projects.title: Smart Arduino Car with Unity Control & Visualization
projects.description: Developed a smart car using Arduino and ESP modules, featuring real-time control and feedback via a custom Unity interface. The system allows users to control the car through Unity while simultaneously visualizing its movement in the virtual environment. Integrated ultrasonic sensors and obstacle avoidance logic on the Arduino enable the car to navigate safely and autonomously when needed.

projects.title: Adventure of the Galaxy Mobile Game
projects.description: Self-published a mobile game in collaboration with a fellow developer, an artist, and my professor—the Head of the Computer Science Department at my university. The game was featured on Google Play and reached over 11,000 downloads, reflecting its success and positive reception.

projects.title: Docamii (Gamification project)
projects.description: A gamified learning prototype developed for the Covid-19 Virtual Hackathon: Egypt, where it won Second Place among 727 teams in the Digital Corona Hackathon. The project aimed to tackle the decline in educational productivity during the pandemic, particularly among children who found online classes boring and disengaging. Our solution introduced an immersive, interactive learning experience with gamification elements — allowing students to learn through play, customize their own characters, and personalize their virtual classrooms.

projects.title: Steampunk Sokoban Puzzle
projects.description:
A mobile puzzle game with 1,000+ handcrafted levels and six difficulty tiers.
I led the full development in Unity, including custom mechanics like bombs, portals, and an autosolver.
Features include undo, save/resume, and a unique theme with a chicken pushing eggs to nests.
Built for high replayability, polished gameplay, and scalable level design.
